items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: Landing pages ship in 1 to 2 weeks. Mobile apps and web platforms usually run 6 to 12 weeks depending on scope. IoT systems vary, and we provide a milestone timeline after discovery.

items.question: Do you work with clients outside my country?
items.answer: Yes. We are a remote-first studio and work with businesses across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. We align with your time zone and communicate asynchronously when needed.

items.question: What happens after the project is delivered?
items.answer: You receive documented source code, deployment credentials, and a handoff session. Retainer packages are also available for ongoing maintenance, hosting, and feature work.

items.question: Do you integrate payment gateways?
items.answer: Yes. We regularly integrate Stripe, Paystack, Flutterwave, M-Pesa, and other regional payment providers, and we design flows for variable connectivity and diverse devices.

items.question: What is your payment structure?
items.answer: Typically 40% to start, 40% at the midpoint milestone, and 20% on delivery. Productized services are 50/50, and retainers are billed monthly in advance.

items.question: Can you work with our existing team or codebase?
items.answer: Absolutely. We can augment your team, audit existing architecture, or take over a stalled project. Discovery calls are free and help us assess fit.
